_comment: Remembered design decisions from the 2026-07-21 complexity refactor (validation_artifacts/complexity_decision.md). JSON form because this environment runs the CLI under bare python3 without PyYAML (references/fitness_functions.md). Advisory: a FIRED rule notifies future agents, it never blocks.

fitness_functions.name: bound-stays-proportional
fitness_functions.description: domains stay sized to the behavior's distinctions (orders/shipped 0..3, retries 0..2, auditLog 0..12 gave bound 624); re-widened counters or reintroduced bookkeeping state should trip this

fitness_functions.name: audit-cap-is-the-only-hub
fitness_functions.description: auditLog is the one accepted dense row (the cap really does stop every action); a second god-state variable (a mode/dirty-style stamp) or a second dense column beyond ShipOrder's guard read is a regression

fitness_functions.name: all-state-load-bearing
fitness_functions.description: every variable is invariant-read and carries a justification
